exposure: anticoagulation (warfarin and unfractionated heparin) for mechanical heart valves during pregnancy
outcome: poor foetal outcomes (miscarriages, terminations, early neonatal death)
cohort: The study included 29 pregnant patients with mechanical heart valves who were receiving anticoagulation (warfarin and unfractionated heparin) from a tertiary single-centre cardiac-obstetric clinic.
finding: The study found high rates of maternal complications (including death, major haemorrhage, thrombosis, and hospitalisation) and poor foetal outcomes in anticoagulated pregnant patients with mechanical heart valves, despite centralised care.
mod_finding: HIV positivity was significantly associated with surgical delivery (p = 0.0017).
